references.text: Moses felt inadequate to speak for God, but God assured him that He would be with his mouth and teach him what to say, reflecting the idea that it is God's Spirit speaking through people.
Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, spoke to the people, illustrating how it was not himself who spoke, but God's Spirit through him.
Paulus, filled with the Holy Spirit, spoke to Elymas, showing that it was God's Spirit who spoke through him.
